howto.what: 装上后，当被问到Phoenix、LiveView、Ecto、OTP或Oban的示例代码、操作步骤或正确实现时，Claude会提供相应的代码片段和演练，并参考官方指南和插件特有的规则与工作流。
howto.when: 当你询问Phoenix、LiveView、Ecto、OTP或Oban的示例代码、操作演练、正确实现或预期工作流输出时触发。

say.text: 请给我一个Phoenix LiveView的聊天例子。
演示一下Oban作业的正确实现。
say.note: Claude会提供作业定义和调用示例。

say.text: 如何用Ecto进行多表查询？请给个示例。
say.note: Claude会给出查询代码和解释。

howto.what_en: When asked for example code, walkthroughs, or proper implementations for Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto, OTP, or Oban, Claude provides code snippets and step-by-step guides, referencing official documentation and plugin-specific patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request example code, walkthroughs, proper implementations, or expected workflow output for Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto, OTP, or Oban.

say_en.text: Give me a Phoenix LiveView chat example.
say_en.note: Claude will show code and steps.

say_en.text: Show me a proper Oban job implementation.
say_en.note: Claude will provide worker and call example.
